public_rationale: OpenAI has undertaken a price cut and continued commercial activity. Neither fact settles whether its measures will ultimately fail. The forecast gives no deadline, and no decisive terminal failure or durable financial success was established by October 28.
limitations: The wording does not define sustainability or its required duration.
The claim's literal reference to every imaginable trick cannot be exhaustively tested.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Before OpenAI dies, its attempts to show it can become a real business (price increases, price cuts, selling off IP, nebulous circular deals and so on) will all fail, and by the end Sam Altman will have run through every trick imaginable to keep the party going.

statement.excerpt: These attempts — price increases, price cuts, selling off IP, nebulous circular deals, and so on — will all fail, and by the end, Sam Altman will have run through every single trick imaginable to keep the party going.

from_speaker: price increases, price cuts, selling off IP, nebulous circular deals
every single trick imaginable to keep the party going
our_interpretation: The surrounding sentence predicts OpenAI's eventual business failure after unsuccessful rescue efforts. 'Before OpenAI dies' supplies an expected sequence, rather than an independent condition that exempts the prediction from assessment.
The plain reading of failure is failure to establish a financially sustainable continuing business.
Every trick imaginable is rhetorical emphasis. The testable commitment concerns material measures actually attempted, including the listed examples if undertaken.
Temporary survival, a financing round, customer growth, or a single profitable period would not alone establish lasting success.
This is a qualitative business-survival forecast, not a forecast of a specified financial amount.
criteria.support_condition: A terminal business failure, supported by restructuring and financial records, establishes that OpenAI's material rescue measures failed to create a sustainable continuing business.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable financial and operational records establish durable commercial viability attributable to at least one material measure covered by the prediction.
